name: Plot 2D
description: Chart an acoustic parameter (a dot per band, joined by a line), or the time or frequency response of Analyse Impulse Response (a line per channel), on the canvas: one chart per parameter connected, stacked, for every source-receiver pair of Analyse Impulse Response. Choose which parameter to chart with the Select parameter dropdown beside the data input: T30 until you choose, All, or one by name (EDT, T20, T30, C50, C80, D50, DRR, Ts, STI, G, SPL, LF; the opened menu gives each its title, as T30 (Reverberation Time)); it lists only the parameters connected, so no LF for a response that is not ambisonic; the time and frequency responses are charted whichever is chosen, and with only them connected the dropdown rests. Drag the corner to resize; hover a chart to read its values; Save writes the charts as a PNG image.
